pay_salary_schedule_001.evidence: APPENDIX A ... SALARY SCHEDULES ... The salary scale for the 2007-2008 and 2009-2010 school years shall be as shown following paragraph 9 of this Appendix A.

pay_step_increment_003.evidence: Open periods to record credit shall extend thirty (30) days beyond the beginning of either school semester and pay adjustment shall be retroactive to the beginning of the same semester.
pay_step_increment_003.coder_notes: Stage 1 evidence quoted a deadline for recording academic credit, which does not explain annual step advancement. The document provides a salary schedule table by years of experience but does not explicitly detail the step advancement process.

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: All teachers shall receive full credit on the salary schedule for full-time outside school-teaching experience in pre-K to 12 accredited schools completed after the teacher received a Bachelor's degree.
